dedupe_keys.name: turkiye maden combined mining site geojson inventory

description: Türkiye Maden combines publicly located mines, quarries, mineral occurrences and mining surface footprints into one Turkish GeoJSON inventory. The maintainer aytzey reports a 30 June 2026 working release with 5,282 deduplicated features from 5,901 source records. Inputs include USGS, EGDI, GEM, PANGAEA, OpenStreetMap, Wikidata and GeoNames. Attributes retain source identifiers, URLs, licence terms, commodity confidence and quality flags; geometry is a footprint or representative point. The public repository includes the GeoJSON file, data dictionary and quality reports. Access is free, with source-specific licences including ODbL, CC BY and CC BY-SA; the documentation is CC BY 4.0. A central limitation is that 4,093 features lack commodity information and operating status is not consistently verified. The collection is explicitly a working inventory, not a legal mining-permit register. Simulation uses include screening mining exposure, locating candidate industrial loads and comparing spatial source coverage. It complements data-usgs-mrdata-mineral-resources-online-spatial-data and data-gem-global-coal-mine-tracker, while preserving, not resolving their differing source meanings.
